gold_row.question: What voltage did sensor 5.0 measure on 2004-02-28 at 02:30:16?
gold_row.gold_cypher:
MATCH (s:Sensor {mote_id: 5})-[:GENERATED]->(m:Measurement)
WHERE m.time STARTS WITH "2004-02-28T02:30:16"
RETURN m.time AS time, m.voltage AS value
ORDER BY m.time ASC
LIMIT 1
